title: Global recovery of a scalar diffusivity from a single final state
summary: We prove global uniqueness and Lipschitz stability for a scalar diffusivity in the heat equation from a single final state at any prescribed positive time. On each prescribed uniformly elliptic $C^{1,α}$-bounded class with known coefficient boundary values, we choose a constant initial datum and a spatially constant exponential boundary input that work for the entire class. The result holds on smooth bounded connected domains in every dimension $n\ge2$ and gives an affirmative answer to \cite[Problem~8.2]{Alessandrini} within these classes.
